description: Evidence for whether an intervention could be shown to have taken effect, from the records you supply. Read-only view of the records you supply; it writes, signs and executes nothing. Needs TRUST_GATE_API_URL, TRUST_GATE_API_KEY and TRUST_GATE_TENANT_ID to be set, and the tenant comes from that setting, never from an argument. Returns status OK, REFUSED or UNAVAILABLE (a missing setting, a surface that is off, or an error is UNAVAILABLE, never made-up data). The Trust Gate API must be a version that serves this view; it returns UNAVAILABLE until then. A mapping or readout is not a compliance finding.
name: get_intervention_evidence
